_meta.title: Motify — Meet the People Around You
_meta.description: Motify uses Bluetooth to connect you with the people in the same place — a conference, a hostel, a café. Real proximity, not GPS.

hero_sub: Motify uses Bluetooth to connect you with the people in the same place — a conference, a hostel, a café, an airport. Real proximity, not GPS.
modes_sub: One profile. Turn on only the modes you want — each works independently.
mode_social_desc: See who's around you, share short posts, and start a chat in the moment.
mode_networking_desc: Meet nearby professionals and exchange work cards for real opportunities.
mode_dating_title: Match with people you click with
mode_dating_desc: Build a dating profile and match with people nearby — only when you both opt in.
modes_note: Turn any mode on or off anytime — your profile stays the same.
how_sub: Three steps to start talking to the people in the same room.
how_1_desc: Go about your day. Motify works quietly in the background over Bluetooth Low Energy.
how_2_desc: When another Motify user shares the same space, you both appear on each other's radar.
how_3_desc: Read posts from the people around you or send a quick hello — while you're still in the same place.
why_sub: Built for real connections, not endless scrolling.
why_1_desc: We use Bluetooth, never location tracking. You see people who are actually near you, and your location is never shared or stored.
why_2_desc: Encrypted, rotating Bluetooth identifiers. No location history. No data sold to advertisers.
why_3_desc: You only appear to people you'd also see. Becoming visible is a deliberate choice, not a set-and-forget switch.
why_4_desc: Connected with someone nearby? Start a conversation in the moment — you're already in the same place.
cta_title: Ready to meet the people around you?
cta_sub: Stop scrolling through profiles thousands of miles away. Start connecting with the people in the same place as you.
